title: More ender eyes
description: New eyes with new powers for your adventure !
body:
![more ender eyes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/78207082bb343a35eabb157462249c9142ddacb1.png)

This mod introduces two new types of End Eyes and a new ore:

- Escape Eye
- Echo Eye
- Ametrine Ore

→ Escape Eye:
If you find yourself in a difficult situation during your mining session, this eye will be your best ally to reach the surface in milliseconds! Are you lost? Are you about to die? Think of this eye!
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/sUCDbzD0U1E" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

→ Water Escape Eye:
Similar to the previous eye, it allows you, if you are ONLY underwater, to reach the surface if you run out of oxygen, for example... (don't try this in a lava flow, obviously).
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/9TGIzk7MSNM" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

→ Echo Eye:
Have you ever died? If you're in Minecraft, this eye from the depths will teleport you to the exact spot of your last death! It's strongly advised against using it if you've drowned in lava or... in the End(the echo eye only works in vanilla dimensions).
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Z5JwCXzQG08" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

→ Ametrine Ore: You'll find this magnificent ore in rocky peaks. For now, it will only serve as an ingredient to craft your escape eye. Remember to bring your diamond pickaxe for the occasion.

Craft : ![craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c4d74b46083efc1b1e8ed7b4a7b3e8dda5da504e.png)
